notes: Large-source-unit check on בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר → *whithersoever*: each of the three morphemes' senses is carried by the single English word, so the grouping is indivisible and is retained, headed on the relative with כֹּל the named alternative — the same reading as JOS.1.7 and JOS.1.16.
The fronted *Have* is the interrogative particle's under rule 17, leaving צִוִּיתִי its subject pronoun and lexical verb.
עִמְּךָ is the clause's prepositional predicate and takes the construction-supplied copula, headed on *with* (rule 49).
